[中文](#cn-v0.2.1) | [English](#en-v0.2.1)

**一条蓝湖编辑页链接引出的修复。** 这种链接会把**文档**与**设计稿**混在一起 —— `docId` + `image_id` + `versionId`
同时出现，而那个 `versionId` 属于**文档**。顺着测下去发现：插件把 URL 里的版本号**整个丢掉了**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.2.1">新增功能</h3>

- **「你浏览器里看的是哪一版，读的就是哪一版」**：链接里带的 `versionId` 现在会作为默认版本。
  以前无论链接指向哪一版，读回来的**永远是 latest**，而且没有任何提示。
- 若 URL 里那个版本**根本不属于这张稿**（编辑页链接的常见情形：版本号属于同链接里的那份文档），
  则**静默退到 latest**，并在结果里写明被忽略的那个 id —— 不报错，也不假装用的就是它。

<h3 id="cn-v0.2.1">体验优化</h3>

- **拿设计稿链接问产品文档时，报错会指路了**：不再只说"项目下没有这个原型文档"，
  而是先查它是不是设计稿，是就明说「这是**设计稿**「Frame 17」，不是产品文档」并指向 `lanhu_read_design`。
  （实测：旧措辞会让 AI 去翻文档列表白跑几轮。）
- README 首屏加上 **「目标是让 AI 更好用」**，并新增「**欢迎各家 AI 提意见**」一节 ——
  列出最想要的四类反馈。这个仓库最想收的不是 star，是**你被它坑过的地方**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.2.1">问题修复</h3>

- **`versionId` 在 `resolveTarget` 里被吞掉**：后果是 URL 指定的版本号**完全失效**。现在带出来了。
- `parseLanhuUrl` 同时补上 `docId` / `pageId`（此前只在产品文档那条链上解析，设计稿这条链直接丢弃）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.2.1">其他变更</h3>

- 自检 **454 → 459 项**：新增**混链回归断言** —— `resolveTarget` 不许再吞掉 `versionId`，
  并覆盖"链接没带版本号时不瞎猜"。
- 显式传 `version` 的严格性**未变**：命中不了照样报 `VERSION_NOT_FOUND`，不被 URL 兜底掩盖。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.2.0...v0.2.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.2.1">New Features</h3>

- **The version you are looking at is the version you get**: a `versionId` in the link is now used as the default.
  Previously the plugin always read `latest` regardless of the link, with no indication that it had done so.
- If that version does not belong to the artboard at all (the usual case for editor links, where the version id
  belongs to the document sharing the URL), it falls back to `latest` **silently but honestly**, reporting the id it
  ignored rather than failing or pretending it was used.

<h3 id="en-v0.2.1">Improvements</h3>

- **Clearer failure when a design link is handed to the product-document tool**: instead of "no prototype document
  with this docId", it now checks whether the id is a design first and reports
  "this is a **design** 「Frame 17」, not a product document", pointing at `lanhu_read_design`.
  (In practice the old wording sent the AI off to browse document lists for several wasted rounds.)
- The README front page now states **"the goal is to make AI more useful"** and adds a
  **"feedback from any AI is welcome"** section listing the four kinds of feedback that help most.

<h3 id="en-v0.2.1">Bug Fixes</h3>

- **`versionId` was swallowed by `resolveTarget`**, which made a version given in the URL completely ineffective. It is
  now carried through.
- `parseLanhuUrl` also keeps `docId` / `pageId`, which were previously parsed only on the product-document path.

<h3 id="en-v0.2.1">Chores</h3>

- Self-check **454 → 459**: new **regression assertions for mixed links** ensuring `resolveTarget` never drops
  `versionId` again, plus coverage for "no version in the link means no guessing".
- Passing `version` explicitly is still strict: an unknown version raises `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` and is never masked by
  the URL fallback.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.2.0...v0.2.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
